figurative_meaning_en: Seeker of favor; Flatterer or sycophant
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একজন পাতচাটা লোক, সবসময় বসের খোঁজা নেয়।
পাতচাটা করে কোনো লাভ হবে না, নিজের কাজে মন দাও।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a bootlicker, always trying to please the boss.
Flattering like that won't help; focus on your work.
note: The idiom derives from the image of someone licking leaves or plates in desperation or flattery, common in rural Bengali expressions.
